data.title: The Cedarwood Secret
data.description: A renowned detective is hired to uncover the mystery of a missing family heirloom, a rare stamp. He must navigate a grand estate and its inhabitants, uncovering subtle clues to reveal the truth behind the disappearance.

characters.name: Kaito Ishikawa
characters.description: Sharp, observant, with a calm demeanor. Wears a classic trench coat and glasses.

characters.name: Anya Petrova
characters.description: Elegant and refined, with long dark hair and piercing blue eyes. Dressed in sophisticated attire.

characters.name: Mr. Caldwell
characters.description: The family's elderly butler, always impeccably dressed in a dark uniform. Stoic expression.

backgrounds.name: Kaito's Office
backgrounds.description: A cozy, slightly cluttered room filled with case files, antique maps, and a worn leather armchair.

backgrounds.name: Petrova Estate - Grand Hall
backgrounds.description: An opulent hall with high ceilings, marble floors, and large portraits. A prominent, empty display case stands in the center.

backgrounds.name: Petrova Estate - Butler's Quarters
backgrounds.description: A small, tidy room with a simple bed, a desk, and a hidden workbench covered in woodworking tools.

script.text: Detective Ishikawa, thank you for seeing me on such short notice.
Of course, Ms. Petrova. Please, have a seat. What seems to be the trouble?
It's my grandfather's 'Blue Dragon' stamp. It's vanished from its display case at the estate.
A 'Blue Dragon'? That's quite a valuable piece. When was it last seen?
Yesterday evening, after a family gathering. Only a few trusted people were present.
Kaito examines the empty display case in the grand hall. The glass is untouched.
No signs of forced entry. It seems whoever took it had access, or was very careful.
It's so unsettling. I just want it back, Detective.
Patience, Ms. Petrova. There's a faint, distinct scent here... almost like cedarwood. And this tiny speck of dust.
Kaito carefully collects the minute wood speck with tweezers, a thoughtful expression on his face.
Mr. Caldwell, I understand you were the last to lock up the hall yesterday?
That is correct, sir. Everything was in order when I retired.
I see. And what about this, Mr. Caldwell?
Kaito points to a small, intricately carved cedarwood box on Caldwell's hidden workbench.
(Stiffens) That... that is my personal project, sir. A gift for Ms. Anya.
Interesting. The same cedarwood scent, the same fine dust... it seems the 'Blue Dragon' found a temporary new home, didn't it?
